sn32.54:1.1: Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yenekadā uṇhaṃ hotīti || || Santi bhikkhu Uṇhavalāhakā nāma devā || || Tesaṃ yadā hoti Yaṃ nuna mayaṃ sakāya ratiyā rameyyāmāti || tesantaṃ cetopaṇidhim anvāya uṇhaṃ hoti || || Ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu ayam paccayo yenekadā uṇhaṃ hotīti || || Sāvatthi || ||
